about.title: About me
about.intro: I see myself as a mathematically minded artist with a love of detail – a true character.

location.text: You will find me on rugged shores, where so many legends originate. I grew up on the Darß and later moved to Rostock to gain life experience, continuing to shape my own path along the way.

thinking.text: Logical thinking and questioning reality at every opportunity have been among my constant companions for as long as I can remember. My education began at Freie Schule Prerow and continued through year 11. After that, I spent 15 eventful years in hospitality before the desire for freedom led me here to pursue my own path.

interests.text: From relaxed gaming to fire shows, animals, nature, and sport run through my life like a common thread, alongside an appreciation of food and culture.

skills.title: My skills
skills.intro: I develop modern web applications across the full stack, using technologies that enable performant, maintainable, and scalable solutions.

cta.text: I am constantly learning and look forward to new challenges. Feel free to get in touch and tell me about your project.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how personal data is processed when this portfolio is used.

hosting.title: 2. Hosting and technical delivery
hosting.infrastructure: The Angular frontend is served through Hostinger. The contact API runs as a Flask backend on a Google Cloud VM. In their capacity as technical service providers, Hostinger and Google may receive connection data.
hosting.connection_data: When the website or contact API is accessed, technically necessary connection and request data is processed. This includes, in particular, the IP address, the time and destination of the request, and technical information transmitted by the browser, such as the user agent or referrer.
hosting.purpose_basis: This processing is used to deliver the website and API and to maintain their stability, security, and protection against misuse. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interests are the secure and reliable delivery of the portfolio.
hosting.retention: Connection data is stored only for as long as necessary for the respective technical or security purpose; statutory retention obligations remain unaffected. The scope and deletion periods of any server logs depend on the production hosting and server configuration.

email_contact.title: 3. Contact form and email delivery
email_contact.data: When the contact form is submitted, the name, email address, and message are processed. The backend also processes the IP address for rate limiting and the value of the hidden honeypot field for spam prevention.
email_contact.process: The Angular frontend transmits the data to the Flask Contact API. The entries are validated on the server and checked to protect against misuse. Valid messages are sent by Gmail SMTP to florianweimann9@gmail.com; the sender's email address is set as the Reply-To address.
email_contact.purpose_basis: The data is processed to handle and respond to the enquiry. Article 6(1)(b) GDPR is the legal basis for pre-contractual communication; Article 6(1)(f) GDPR applies to other enquiries, rate limiting, and spam prevention. The legitimate interests are reliable communication and protecting the form against misuse.
email_contact.storage: The backend does not maintain its own database for contact enquiries. However, the message and the contact details it contains are transmitted through Google/Gmail and may be stored in the recipient's Gmail mailbox and in Google's systems. The retention period there depends on the handling of the enquiry, deletion from the mailbox, Google's settings and procedures, and any applicable statutory retention obligations.
email_contact.provision: Providing the information is voluntary. Without the fields marked as required, the message cannot be sent through the form or answered.

language_storage.title: 4. Language selection in the browser
language_storage.text: When German or English is actively selected, the website stores the language preference in the browser's local storage. This allows the selected language to be reused on later visits. The language preference is not transmitted to the server as part of this storage operation.
language_storage.legal_note: The entry is used solely to provide the language explicitly selected by the user. The storage is necessary for this purpose within the meaning of Section 25(2)(2) TDDDG. It remains until the selection is changed or the entry is deleted through the browser settings.

cookies_analytics.title: 5. Cookies, analytics, and tracking
cookies_analytics.text: Based on its current technical implementation, this portfolio does not itself set tracking cookies and does not use analytics, tracking, or advertising services. The language preference in localStorage is not a cookie and is described in the preceding section.

fonts.title: 6. Fonts
fonts.text: The Figtree font is served locally by this website. Loading the font does not establish a connection to Google Fonts or any other external font provider.

external_links.title: 7. External links
external_links.text: This website contains links to external services, in particular GitHub, LinkedIn, and project demos. A connection to the respective third party is only established when such a link is actively opened. From that point, the third party processes data under its own privacy terms.

rights.title: 8. Data subject rights
rights.intro: Where the respective statutory requirements are met, the following rights apply in particular:
rights.access: Access to processed personal data under Article 15 GDPR
rights.rectification: Rectification of inaccurate data under Article 16 GDPR
rights.erasure: Erasure of personal data under Article 17 GDPR
rights.restriction: Restriction of processing under Article 18 GDPR
rights.objection: Objection to processing based on legitimate interests under Article 21 GDPR
rights.complaint: Lodging a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority under Article 77 GDPR
